titles.title: BINSA Act
Biotech Investment National Security Act of 2026
BINSA Act
A bill to amend title VIII of the Defense Production Act of 1950 to include biotechnology in the definitions of "prohibited technology" and "notifiable technology", and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
